text: Hi Reef. Welcome to Summit One. In maths, a difficult-looking problem can hide a clever idea. What is the last digit of seven to the power of two thousand and twenty-seven? Let's find the pattern. The A M C, Mawa and Rossmoyne reward careful thinking.

voices.label: Polished and reassuring
voices.description: A mature male professional audiobook narrator with a cultivated, subtle Australian English accent. Smooth clear medium-low baritone, warm rounded tone and precise diction. Formal, pleasant and reassuring educational narration. Slow measured delivery, generous pauses between sentences, even gentle volume, restrained intonation. Comfortable effortless listening for a long audiobook. Clean dry studio audio.

voices.label: Gentle and refined
voices.description: A refined male documentary narrator, with clear standard British English pronunciation. A smooth mellow mid-range voice, gentle resonance, articulate and quietly warm. Formal composed delivery with a measured unhurried pace and distinct pauses. Understated expression, soft sentence endings, calm steady dynamics. A pleasant voice for hours of educational listening. Clean studio recording.

notes: Original synthetic voice designs, not clones of a real speaker.
Two formal male designs: subtle Australian and standard British. Listener review determines preference.
Mawa is written as a word in the synthesis text to avoid spelling out the acronym.
This audition does not replace the approved welcome or course narration.
